notes: The word showcase puts this in Entertainment, and the build is a three-storey cottage-core house with fully accessible interiors on every floor, set in a small detailed cottage garden. No catalogue shape covers it, so it is a described shape: interior-single is out because the author kept the garden, so there is an exterior to generate and a doorway to link; space-bounded assumes one level and this is three the player moves between; rooms-sequence assumes rooms worked through in order, where a house connects freely; and route-guided would fit a walked showcase but routes flat P0, losing both the inside-outside transition and the stacked floors that are the whole structure here. The axes carry it instead — transition enclosure and stacked verticality — which is what produces P3 plus P2, and building-interior is the option form of the same stated feature. Decided without a user: Showcase's three options kept as-is, since a house showcase is exactly a hero focal build with a composed arrival from the garden gate, and many details and features reads as vignette spots distinct from the hero elevation; both modifiers are earned by stated features rather than assumed, but neither route is ready yet, so this build waits on them rather than being flattened.
